notes: Breadboard hole names follow the row letters printed in the image: rows a-e (lower half in the picture) are bank 't', rows f-j (upper half) are bank 'b'. Bottom power rails are bn (top line of the pair, black/-) and bp (red/+).
Exact rail hole numbers (bp.2, bn.2, bp.4, bn.9) are estimated from the image; only the rail strip matters electrically.
The pushbutton straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6, so all four legs are inserted (4b.f, 6b.f, 4t.e, 6t.e). Which legs are internally connected is left to the catalogue.

Button leg column 4 goes to 5V via the orange wire at 4t.c. Column 6 goes to pin 2 via the teal wire at 6b.i, and to the 10k pull-down resistor (6t.c to 9t.c). Column 9 goes to the GND rail via the short black wire (9t.b to bn.9).
The built-in LED on pin 13 is on the Uno board, so no external LED is added. The manual lists no external LED circuit.
Resistor type is the catalogue 'resistor' with value=10000 (10k ohm).
